subject: math
l2: 一元微分学（求导与作图）
question: 设 $f'(0) = 1$ , $f''(0) = 0$ ，证明在 $x = 0$ 处，有 $\frac{\mathrm{d}^2}{\mathrm{d}x^2} f(x^2) = \frac{\mathrm{d}^2}{\mathrm{d}x^2} f^2(x)$ .

steps.text: 分析 因为 $\frac{\mathrm{d}^2}{\mathrm{d}x^2} f(x^2) = \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x}\left[2xf'(x^2)\right]$ ， $\frac{\mathrm{d}^2}{\mathrm{d}x^2} f^2(x) = \frac {d}{dx}[2f(x)f'(x)]$ ，所以只需验证 $2xf'(x^2)$ 与 $2f(x)f'(x)$ 在 $x = 0$ 处有相同的导数.
因为 $f''(0) = 0$ ，所以 $f'(x)$ 在 $x = 0$ 处可导，因此 $f'(x)$ 在 $x = 0$ 处连续。令 $F(x) = f(x^2)$ ，则

\begin{array}{r l}\frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2}}{\mathrm{d} x ^ {2}} f (x ^ {2}) \Bigg | _ {x = 0}&= \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x} F ^ {\prime} (x) \Bigg | _ {x = 0} = \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {F ^ {\prime} (x) - F ^ {\prime} (0)}{x}\\&= \lim _ {x \rightarrow 0} \frac {2 x f ^ {\prime} (x ^ {2})}{x} = 2 f ^ {\prime} (0) = 2.\end{array}
G ^ {\prime} (x) = 2 f (x) f ^ {\prime} (x), \quad G ^ {\prime} (0) = 2 f (0) f ^ {\prime} (0) = 2 f (0).

\begin{array}{r l} \frac {\mathrm{d} ^ {2}}{\mathrm{d} x ^ {2}} f ^ {2} (x) \Bigg | _ {x = 0} & = \frac {\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x} G ^ {\prime} (x) \Bigg | _ {x = 0} = \lim _ {x \to 0} \frac {G ^ {\prime} (x) - G ^ {\prime} (0)}{x} \\ & = \lim _ {x \to 0} \frac {2 f (x) f ^ {\prime} (x) - 2 f (0)}{x} \\ & = 2 \lim _ {x \to 0} \frac {f (x) f ^ {\prime} (x) - f (x) + f (x) - f (0)}{x} \\ & = 2 \lim _ {x \to 0} \frac {f (x) [ f ^ {\prime} (x) - f ^ {\prime} (0) ]}{x} + 2 \lim _ {x \to 0} \frac {f (x) - f (0)}{x} \\ & = 2 f (0) f ^ {\prime \prime} (0) + 2 f ^ {\prime} (0) = 2. \end{array}
